title: Russia and China 'ready to embarrass Trump' with disclosure about alien contact
excerpt: EXCLUSIVE: A leading UFO researcher has claimed that Russia and China are 'ready' to reveal that humans are in contact with an extraterrestrial civilisation.
content:
EXCLUSIVE: A leading UFO researcher has claimed that Russia and China are "ready" to reveal that humans are in contact with an extraterrestrial civilisation.

09:43 ET, Wed, Sep 23, 2026 Updated: 09:51 ET, Wed, Sep 23, 2026

Russia and China are "ready" to disclose that humanity has established contact with an extraterrestrial civilization in a move designed to "embarrass" Donald Trump and the United States government, according to a sensational claim by a prominent UFO researcher.

Earlier this year, Ukrainian drones demolished a massive 230-foot radio telescope that Ukrainian officials suspected was being utilized to relay targeting data for the Russian military. However, according to Professor Simon Holland, the RT-70 radio telescope was actually being employed for a far more unusual purpose – establishing communication with an extraterrestrial civilization.

The radio telescope located in Crimea was linked to GLONASS, Russia's GPS network, and on August 31, it was destroyed by Ukrainian drones. Prior to its destruction, the telescope was undoubtedly utilized as part of multiple projects designed to make contact with alien life

  • Mystery behind famous ‘Wow! signal’ once linked to aliens may finally be solved
  • Alien life breakthrough after atmosphere detected surrounding Earth-like planet

However, most of the transmissions sent from Crimea are constrained by the speed of light, and have not yet reached their intended targets.

One radio transmission was directed toward an apparently Earth-like planet circling the star Gliese 58, just under 21 light-years from Earth. It's anticipated to be the first to reach its destination. If anyone is present to receive it, the transmission will arrive in 2029.

The antenna sent transmissions towards the Cygnus, Sagitta, Cassiopeia, Orion, Andromeda, Ursa, Major, Delphinus, Gemini, Virgo and Hydra constellations, (Image: Getty Images)

However, Simon told us, certain transmissions have been sent utilizing a groundbreaking new quantum-tunneling technology that surpasses that universal speed limit. And, he adds, prior to the telescope's destruction, researchers had already received a response.

Simon explains: "At the beginning of the 21st century, a German physics researcher at the University of Koblenz, called Günter Nimitz, proved that you could, do quantum tunnelling with a signal."

"The interesting thing about quantum tunnelling is that when you inject the signal into an object which could be a metre or it could be a 1,000,000 miles away, it comes out the other end at the same time it goes in. There is no transit. So it's faster than the speed of light. It's instantaneous."

Simon claims to be in contact with a program insider, though he declined to identify his source, stating: "It's somebody I know who's originally British. He's been head of a large European radio telescope organisation. He now is out in the Far East and has contact, obviously, with Russia. He's part of this METI [sending messages to extraterrestrial intelligence] team."

Although the RT-70 radio telescope has been decommissioned, Simon's source alleges that Russia continues to exchange communications with this enigmatic alien world. According to the claims, Russia has shared its quantum messaging technology with China, and both nations are reportedly planning a startling disclosure, which they hope will "embarrass" the US government.

Professor Simon Holland is a science filmmaker with deep contacts within the UFO community (Image: YouTube)

"There is an ET arms race," Simon asserts. So far, the insider has not revealed when Russia and China intend to release this groundbreaking information: "I asked him, and he said they'll use the information to embarrass Trump or whoever. But there's no set date."

As of now, he notes, although the researchers have received a message, they have not yet translated it.

Simon suggests he's reasonably confident all major global powers have access to this intelligence: "Britain knows, France knows, the rest of the world knows.

"America knows, and they're holding it back due to Congress asking silly questions, and mainly due to defence contractors, not wanting to reveal what they're actually using from observations of UAP characteristics. So everybody actually knows."

He references an official MOD document from 1999 that acknowledged UAPs as a legitimate phenomenon: "They've written a NATO protocol for airmen and women on how to avoid them. And they're not a threat to national security because they don't know what they are."

The Gliese 581 star system is home to one of the the most earth-like exoplanets yet discovered (Image: Getty Images)

However, he claims the US and UK governments are declining to release their findings about the experiments: "They're actually holding back what you might call disclosure. I prefer to call it confirmation. But they're not really just going there."

"Obviously," Simon states, "Russia and China have made contact in some way or know also that it's real. They've had lots of sightings recorded and, possibly, this radio telescope system has confirmed it.

"But it's a political decision as to when Russia and China announced. Another interesting part of the story," Simon continues, "is that the Vatican has briefed bishops throughout the world."

Leading clergy members have received a pre-written statement for their congregations, which Simon has reviewed. It states: "We are not alone, when this becomes public, bishops, tell your congregation, God makes all creatures in the universe. That's our position."

He believes it's merely a question of when the truth will be made public: "Everybody knows the fact. It's not being disclosed. So when are they going to do it? I don't know."
